paper.title: Algorithm 785: A software package for computing Schwarz-Christoffel conformal transformation for doubly connected polygonal regions
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 24(3), September 1998, pp. 317-333 (archive header: VOL. 24, NO. 3, September 1998, P. 317-333)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 785.gz (scouted 2026-11-27, gz sha256 55965a41f823fb161c5df7b59933092f3879b7a8b57636859511be5c3f4f9175). Fortran77/Src/Dp/src.f, Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/driver.f, data, and the shipped run transcript Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/RES.

claim.location: Shipped run transcript Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/RES, inside 785.gz (sha256 of the extracted text is not recorded; the transcript is the text between 'cat << SHAR_EOF > RES' and the closing SHAR_EOF, about lines 39-465 of the decompressed shell archive). Its example 1 (problem 1, square-symmetric region, NPTQ=7, M=4, N=4, TOL=0.1E-09; the menu line '6 AN EX. GIVEN BY REFEREE' printed under every block is not the example label) prints the solved parameters 'U= 0.4559381277686' and 'C=( 1.8134230823216,-1.8134230823303)'. The transcript is the list of keyboard answers the interactive driver reads, followed by the printed output.

reference.sha256: not recorded for the extracted transcript; the archive sha256 is 55965a41f823fb161c5df7b59933092f3879b7a8b57636859511be5c3f4f9175

claim.metric: Solved map parameters for example 1: the real parameter U and the complex accessory parameter C (real and imaginary parts), as printed to 13 decimals.
claim.paper_value: Not located: the paper (ACM TOMS 24(3) 1998) is paywalled and was not read. The shipped transcript is the value to check.

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The driver's nonlinear solve is stopped at TOL=0.1E-09 (printed in the transcript), and the printed imaginary part of C differs from its real part's magnitude only at the 1e-11 level, so the solver's own noise is near 1e-10. 1e-7 is about a thousand times that noise and small against the 13-digit values printed. Not loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute for example 1 with NPTQ=7 (interactive driver, scripted answers).
cost.data_size: Archive about 90 KB (4662 lines in the decompressed shell archive).
cost.data_licence: Not stated in the archive; a Collected Algorithm from ACM TOMS. The rerun should record the licence it finds.

why: The driver is a Fortran 77 program with a shipped run transcript, so the solved accessory parameters of a published test example can be compared with the transcript to 1e-7 without needing the paper's own tables.
